turns.content: I've been getting into film photography. Just developed my first roll and the results were better than expected.
Film has a beautiful quality that's hard to replicate digitally. What camera are you using?
A Pentax K1000 I found at a car boot sale. It's completely mechanical which I love.
The K1000 is a great learner camera — fully manual, nearly indestructible. What film did you shoot?
Kodak ColorPlus 200. I hear it's forgiving for beginners.
Good choice for outdoor light. Are you developing at home or sending to a lab?
Sending to a lab for now. I want to learn to develop black and white at home eventually.
B&W home development is very satisfying and the chemistry is simpler than colour. Highly recommend starting with it.
